rows.issue: The re-rank rows at 4 and 1 kg/m3 presume a structural core that does not exist today. MAINLINE-007 retrieved no catalog core with sourced shear modulus, compressive modulus and strength below 16 kg/m3 (Plascore lightest 16, ROHACELL IG-F starts 31, HexWeb lightest retrieved 24; Schaedler nickel microlattice 0.9 kg/m3 has no retrieved modulus or strength).
rows.consequence: Every light-core row in this card is PROJECTION on the core side regardless of face material. The wrinkling comparison on those rows uses Ec*Gc products belonging to 24-38 kg/m3 cores, which cannot ride on a 1-4 kg/m3 row at any thickness near the mass ceiling (a 32 kg/m3 core at the 1 kg/m3 row's 0.1884 m thickness would alone mass about 7576 kg against a 4889 kg ceiling).
rows.next: Source or project an ultra-light core with a stated Ec*Gc product and strength; until then the light-core readings measure the core gap, not a build.

rows.issue: The wrinkling criterion sigma_wr = 0.5*(E_f*Ec*Gc)^(1/3) is the flat-panel/dimple formula transferred to a 10 m radius sandwich sphere. Orthotropic honeycomb has no single continuum Ec; the two HexWeb sheets carry no compressive modulus on their datasheets, so their Ec*Gc products stay open (007). Foam products (ROHACELL, Divinycell) are datasheet-derived and QUESTIONABLE.
rows.consequence: The wrinkling column measures a product gap, not a verified failure mode. MAINLINE-007b is sourced to replace this reading.
rows.next: 007b's sourced sandwich-shell shear and wrinkling formulas supersede this column when filed.

rows.issue: The quasi-isotropic moduli 54, 135, 210, 86 and 180 GPa are rounded products of their stated bases (53.6, 136.5, 211.15, 85.68, 179.2); the unidirectional compressive strengths behind 520, 350 and 220 MPa are unnamed.
rows.consequence: Recomputing with the unrounded products does not change any rank order in this card (verified for P2-E by the checker; the light-core rows scale all candidates by the same ratios, so their order is unchanged too).
rows.next: Write each QI modulus as its product and name the UD strengths when the material set is next touched.

rows.issue: At equal face mass the face-thickness change moves the separation slightly; the first-order scaling drops that term. The 008 checker measured the effect at most 0.348 percent of SF_b on P2-E (worst tf/d 0.00722).
rows.consequence: Negligible against the 2-10x gaps this card reports.
rows.next: None alone; folds into any future exact recompute.

rows.issue: The P3 columns use the thin-wall tube figures; the approximation is weakest on P3-A where tw/ro = 0.175.
rows.consequence: P3 rows are order-of-magnitude readings; nothing in P3 passes anyway.
rows.next: None unless a candidate family approaches P3 feasibility.

rows.issue: The conservative SP-8032 factor is a monocoque cap curve transferred to the sandwich (phi = pi, t_eq = (6 tf d^2)^(1/3)); the central 0.20 is monocoque dome evidence; the 0.90 carry is from shells at lambda 1.58-33.18 while this sphere sits near lambda 65-68.
rows.consequence: All three levels are QUESTIONABLE; the optimistic 0.90 is outside the regime by 004b's own reading.
rows.next: 007b-adjacent: a sandwich-specific knockdown for this geometry.
